title: Maximum width over a finite family
statement: Let $\kappa$ be a finite type, let $m,w\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $F$ assign to each $k\in\kappa$ a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists. Define $T$ to be the maximum, over $k\in\kappa$, of the width value associated with $m,w$, and $F(k)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ assigns a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists to each $k\in\kappa$.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the width value being maximized, so its meaning cannot be described more specifically.
